The '''Skyline River Pass''' was a canyon located in the [[Western Jungle Expanse]] of the [[Horizon Island]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skyline River Pass appears as an area on Rishi in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
